claims.text: Life-threatening bleed: IVIG 1 g/kg daily for 1-2 days, or anti-D immune globulin 75 mcg/kg IV once (Rh-positive, ⍉splenectomized; can cause severe hemolysis and DIC).
claims.quote: In children or adults with immune thrombocytopenia and life-threatening bleeding, rapid phagocytic blockade is attempted by giving IVIG 1 g/kg once a day for 1 to 2 days or, in Rh-positive patients, a single dose of IV anti-D immune globulin 75 mcg/kg. IV anti-D immunoglobulin is only effective in patients who have not had a splenectomy, and it may be associated with severe complications such as severe hemolysis and disseminated intravascular coagulation

claims.text: Rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV wkly for 4 wks (response 57%).
claims.quote: Rituximab (375 mg/m 2 IV once a week for 4 weeks) has a response rate of 57%, but only 21% of adult patients remain in remission after 5 years
